title: 134 Walton Gulfview | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… "134 Walton Gulfview," a beautifully appointed Seacrest West retreat with a private heated pool, spacious outdoor living areas and room for up to 11 guests. Spend sunny afternoons lounging by the pool, prepare dinner in the chef's kitchen or gather outside for an evening of al fresco dining. With four bedrooms, inviting interiors and 6 bikes included for exploring the nearby communities of 30A, this home makes it easy to settle in and enjoy your time along the coast. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Heated Pool with tanning ledge, surrounded by lush landscapingExpansive Outdoor Living Area with covered porches, outdoor kitchen and fireplaceChef's Kitchen featuring Thermador appliances and beautiful Quartzite countertopsSpacious 4-Bedroom Retreat accommodating up to 11 guests, with private bathrooms for every bedroomOpen-Concept Living Area with 83-inch Smart TV and SONOS sound systemGulf-View Porch off the third-floor bunk suite6 Bikes Included for exploring Scenic Highway 30A and nearby communitiesPrime Seacrest West Location near Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seagrove BeachEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Set up perfectly for families or reunions with a well-stocked kitchen, plenty of towels, and a fantastic outdoor space." – Karen H.⭐ "Spacious, clean, and quiet with a great kitchen and outdoor retreat. Comfy beds!"– Marti C.⭐ "Fantastic pool and outdoor area in a perfect location. Highly recommend!"– Dusty M.*** LIVING AREAS ***The open-concept living area at "134 Walton Gulfview" brings everyone together, with comfortable seating, beautiful natural light and direct access to the outdoor living spaces. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning at home or settling in for a movie after a day by the pool, there's plenty of room to relax.Spacious Living Area with comfortable seating and modern coastal interiorsLarge Windows bringing in plenty of natural light83-Inch Smart TV with SONOS sound system for movie nights and entertainmentDirect Access to Outdoor Living Areas for easy indoor and outdoor entertaining*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***From slow mornings over coffee to evenings spent cooking together, the kitchen is one of the home's standout spaces. Beautiful Quartzite countertops, premium Thermador appliances and a spacious island make everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners feel easy. Gather around the dining table or enjoy a meal outside in the fresh coastal air.Chef's Kitchen with Thermador appliances and Quartzite countertopsSpacious Kitchen Island with seating for casual diningDining Area with seating for 8Fully Equipped Kitchen with cookware, utensils and small appliancesOutdoor Kitchen with grill, sink and seating for al fresco dining*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***With four bedrooms spread across three floors, "134 Walton Gulfview" offers a comfortable layout for families and groups traveling together. Each bedroom has its own bathroom, giving everyone a little extra privacy throughout their stay.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed and En-Suite with dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in showerPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchen2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower3rd FloorBunk Suite: Queen-over-Queen bunk bed, Twin trundle, Gulf-view balcony and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The outdoor spaces at "134 Walton Gulfview" are made for enjoying time together. Spend sunny afternoons lounging beside the private pool, prepare dinner in the outdoor kitchen or gather around the fireplace as the evening winds down. With spacious covered porches, comfortable seating and beautiful landscaping, there's plenty of room to relax and enjoy the coastal air.Private Heated Pool with tanning ledge and surrounding tropical landscapingOutdoor Fireplace with comfortable seating for relaxing eveningsExpansive Covered Porches with comfortable outdoor seatingOutdoor Kitchen with grill, sink and space for gatheringPing Pong Table and mini basketball hoop over the poolAl Fresco Dining and outdoor entertaining areasGulf-View Porch accessible from the third-floor bunk suite*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked away in Seacrest West, "134 Walton Gulfview" offers a quieter setting while keeping some of 30A's favorite communities close by. Take one of the included bikes along Scenic Highway 30A, spend an afternoon exploring the shops and restaurants of Alys Beach or head toward Rosemary Beach for dinner and an evening stroll. With Seagrove Beach and plenty of local favorites nearby, there's always something new to discover.Alys Beach nearby for beautiful architecture, restaurants, shopping and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach nearby for boutiques, coffee shops, dining and its charming Town CenterSeagrove Beach nearby for local restaurants, shops and laid-back coastal atmosphereScenic Highway 30A Bike Path for exploring the surrounding communities6 Bikes Included for enjoying the neighborhood and nearby attractions*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Discount and Promotion Restrictions Apply.Pool Heating is available September 1 through April 30Waiver required to access the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesExterior Security Cameras: Active cameras are located at the front porch entrance, back patio and facing the pool equipment*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to creating exceptional vacation experiences. Enjoy 24/7 support and a home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
